title: Making my first AI game, would love some feedback!
author: duyyen01
selftext:
I'm excited to make my first game, but I'm a bit stuck on improving the art style and gameplay. I'd really appreciate any feedback or suggestions. Thanks!  
[Link to game](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4911120/FleshForge/)

comments.author: Turbulent-Armadillo9
comments.body: I like the graphics. It’s all dirty and grimey looking. Not jumping out as ai art at a glance.

comments.author: damocles_paw
comments.body: Have you tried asking AI to improve the art style and gameplay?

replies.author: duyyen01
replies.body: Yeah, I’ve tried a couple of different art styles, but I feel like I’ve hit a wall. Something feels missing from the game, but I can’t figure out what or how to improve it

replies.author: damocles_paw
replies.body: I think you need to look at other games and find a style you like and tell AI to do that style.

comments.author: randommmoso
comments.body: From the video the combat looks very basic and not satisfying at all.

replies.author: duyyen01
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback!, Ai seems have trouble to visualize animation, I’m currently focusing on creating new hand-made animations and skills.
